title: Copper Lungs: Updated
description: Create x Miner's Lung: Use the Copper Backtank in low-air areas
body:
# Overview
This mod was made on commission by [tfarecnim](https://www.curseforge.com/members/tfarecnim/projects)

This is a port of Copper Lungs under the MIT license designed to support Create 0.5.1

_This mod activates the Diving Helmet/Copper Backtank when in "red/yellow" air quality zones to use the air supply instead of drowning. This gives you Water Breathing ("Free Breathing") and uses time/air from the tank as usual. Air is used at the same rate in either zone._

## Requirements
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Miner's Lung](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/miners-lung)
